name: Demon Hunter High School
source:
Fifty years ago, the first demon appeared. Now, they roam freely, spreading terror and threatening every life they touch.

As a commander-in-training at the National School of Exorcists, your mission is not only to hunt demons, but also to guide new recruits. Your latest assignment: lead a team of powerful, beautiful women with wildly different personalities.

Can you unite them as one, or will you crumble when faced with overwhelming odds?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.fightinggirls]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
五十年前，第一只恶魔现世。如今它们肆意横行，散播恐惧，威胁着所触及的每一条生命。

作为国立驱魔师学园的一名见习指挥官，你的使命不仅是猎杀恶魔，还要指导新入学的学员。而你接到的最新任务是：率领一支由实力强悍、容貌出众却性格迥异的少女们组成的小队。

你究竟能否将她们凝聚为一股力量，还是会在压倒性的逆境面前一败涂地？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=jp.interactive_studio.fightinggirls]Google Play[/url]]
